mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (company_id, department_id, users_email, users_nickname, users_profile, users_name, users_point, users_gender, users_kakao_id, users_login_type, users_tel, users_created_at, users_updated_at, users_status, users_rejected_reason, users_pwd) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{departmentId}, #{usersEmail}, #{usersNickname}, #{usersProfile}, #{usersName}, #{usersPoint}, #{usersGender}, #{usersKakaoId}, #{usersLoginType}, #{usersTel}, #{usersCreatedAt}, #{usersUpdatedAt}, #{usersStatus}, #{usersRejectedReason}, md5(#{usersPwd}))
mapper.select: SELECT u.*, c.company_name, d.department_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN company c ON u.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN department d ON u.department_id = d.department_id WHERE u.users_email = #{usersEmail} AND u.users_pwd = md5(#{usersPwd})

SELECT u.*, c.company_name, d.department_name FROM users u INNER JOIN company c ON u.company_id = c.company_id INNER JOIN department d ON u.department_id = d.department_id WHERE u.company_id = #{companyId} AND u.users_id != #{currentUserId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.users_profile IS NOT NULL AND u.users_profile != '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, d.department_name, u.users_name LIMIT 50

SELECT u.*, c.company_name, d.department_name FROM users u INNER JOIN company c ON u.company_id = c.company_id INNER JOIN department d ON u.department_id = d.department_id WHERE u.department_id = #{departmentId} AND u.users_id != #{currentUserId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.users_profile IS NOT NULL AND u.users_profile != '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.users_name LIMIT 20
SELECT u.*, c.company_name, d.department_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN company c ON u.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN department d ON u.department_id = d.department_id WHERE u.users_id = #{userId}
